# Chitra's Lifeline Clinic

> A doctor-led dermatology, cosmetology, skin and laser clinic in Yelahanka New Town, Bengaluru, India, led by Dr. Bindiya G P (MBBS, DDVL), an aesthetic dermatologist and cosmetologist. The clinic has its own laboratory and pharmacy.

## The doctor

- Dr. Bindiya G P, aesthetic dermatologist and cosmetologist, leads the clinic.
- Qualifications: MBBS, DDVL (Dermatology, Venereology and Leprosy).
- Registration: Karnataka Medical Council, Reg. No. 86678.
- More than seven years in dermatology and cosmetology. Trained at Command Hospital Air Force, Bangalore.
- Member of IADVL, IMA, CDSI, ACSI, Bangalore Dermatological Society.

## Visiting and booking

- Address: Ward No. 4, LMN Arcade, 17-B/4, 1169, Opposite Rail Wheel Factory, Yelahanka New Town, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560064 ([Google Maps](https://share.google/BwcyCo6wf4YwJIIGE)).
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM.
- Phone: +91 81975 16940 or +91 99860 86610. WhatsApp: +91 81975 16940.
- Book by phone, by WhatsApp, or with the form on any page. Online consultations are available.
- Whether a treatment suits someone is decided by the doctor at a consultation. Prices, session counts and expected results are not published on the website; ask the clinic.

## Treatments

- [Anti-wrinkle injections](https://skin.chitraslifelineclinic.com/anti-wrinkle-injections): Anti-wrinkle injections for forehead lines, frown lines and crow's feet in Yelahanka New Town, Bengaluru, at a doctor-led clinic with dermatologist Dr. Bindiya G P (MBBS, DDVL).
- [Laser hair reduction](https://skin.chitraslifelineclinic.com/laser-hair-reduction): Laser hair reduction in Yelahanka New Town, Bengaluru, at a doctor-led clinic with dermatologist Dr. Bindiya G P (MBBS, DDVL). Settings suited to Indian skin types.
- [Medi-facials](https://skin.chitraslifelineclinic.com/medi-facials): Medi-facials in Yelahanka New Town, Bengaluru, matched to your skin concern, at a doctor-led clinic with dermatologist Dr. Bindiya G P (MBBS, DDVL).
- [Botox](https://skin.chitraslifelineclinic.com/botox): Botox (botulinum toxin) for forehead lines, frown lines and crow's feet in Yelahanka New Town, Bengaluru, at a doctor-led clinic with dermatologist Dr. Bindiya G P (MBBS, DDVL).
- [All treatments](https://skin.chitraslifelineclinic.com/#treatments): also chemical peels, PRP therapy, acne and acne scars, hair fall, dermal fillers, laser skin treatments, and skin, nail and fungal infections.
